title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
内容提要
这本连环画是根据《西游记》七十二回、七十三回编绘的。
唐僧师徒去西天取经，路过盘丝洞，遇上妖精，把唐僧掳去。悟空、八戒、沙僧等三人救出师父，继续西行。他们来到“黄花观”，又被妖道陷害，幸喜悟空机灵，没有被毒死。悟空搬请毗蓝菩萨破了妖法，救活师父、八戒、沙僧，师徒四人又继续西行。

1 唐僧师徒四人别了朱紫国王，继续向西天行进。这时正值春光明媚，柳绿花香的季节，师徒们好不快活。正走间，忽见前面有一座庄院。
page_text_en:
Content Summary
This comic book is adapted from Chapters 72 and 73 of Journey to the West.
Tang Sanzang and his disciples journeyed west to fetch scriptures. Passing through the Spider Cave, they encountered demons who abducted Master Tang. Wukong, Baijie, and Sha僧 rescued their master and continued westward. They later arrived at the "Huanghua Temple," where they were tricked by a demon priest. Fortunately, Wukong was clever and avoided being poisoned. He then summoned the Bodhisattva Pilan to break the demon's magic, saving Master Tang, Baijie, and Sha僧. The four disciples resumed their journey westward.

1 The four disciples of Tang Sanzang bid farewell to King Zhuzi and continued their journey westward. It was a bright spring day, with willows green and flowers fragrant, and the disciples were very happy. As they walked, they suddenly saw a courtyard ahead.
summary_zh: 本页包含《盘丝洞》连环画的内容提要，概述了唐僧师徒在盘丝洞和黄花观遭遇妖精、被救并继续西行的故事梗概，并以第一幅图画和文字描述了师徒四人告别朱紫国王后，行至春光明媚处，发现一座庄院的情景。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
2 唐僧下了马说：‘徒弟们，前面不远是座庄院，我去化些斋饭来吃。’八戒道：‘化斋饭弟子当去，那能叫师父辛劳。’唐僧道：‘这个去处不远，我去去就来，你们在这里等等吧。’
3 徒弟们见师父执意要去，也就不强加阻拦。唐僧一人进了庄院，一个男人也看不见，只有四个女子，在窗前描花刺绣。
page_text_en:
2 Tang Sanzang dismounted and said, 'Disciples, not far ahead is a farmhouse. I will go to beg some vegetarian food.' Zhu Bajie replied, 'It should be the disciples who go to beg food, how could we let the Master toil?' Tang Sanzang said, 'This place is not far away. I'll be back soon. You stay here and wait.'
3 The disciples, seeing the Master insisted on going, did not strongly object. Tang Sanzang entered the farmhouse alone. There was not a single man to be seen, only four women embroidering flowers by the window.
summary_zh: 唐僧决定独自前往不远处的庄院化斋，徒弟们劝阻未果后让他去，他进入庄院后发现院内只有四个女子在窗前刺绣，不见男子。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
4 唐僧见是女子，上前化缘有些不便，但心里想，我若化不出一顿斋饭，定叫徒弟们笑我无用。就硬着头皮，向里边走去。又见那茅屋旁边，有三个女子在踢气球。
5 唐僧高声叫道：‘女菩萨，贫僧路过这里，化顿斋饭吃。’那些女子听见，个个撇了针线，抛了气球，笑吟吟地说道：‘长老，失迎了，快请里面坐。’
page_text_en:
4 Tang僧 saw that they were women, and felt it was somewhat awkward to beg alms, but he thought to himself, if I can't beg a meal, my disciples will surely laugh at me for being useless. So he gritted his teeth and walked in. He then saw three women playing with a ball near the thatched house.
5 Tang僧 called out loudly: 'Goddesses, a poor monk passes by here, may I beg a meal?' The women heard him, each put down their embroidery and ball, and smiled sweetly, saying: 'Elder, we apologize for the delay, please come in and sit down.'
summary_zh: 唐僧见庄院内有女子，虽觉不便但仍硬着头皮进入，发现她们在踢气球。他高声化缘，女子们闻声放下针线和气球，热情邀请他入内坐客。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
6 众女子把唐僧领进一座石洞。唐僧抬头看时，见铺设的都是石桌、石凳，冷气森森，不由心惊道：‘这地方凶多吉少，不是个善地！’
7 唐僧不能脱身，没奈何只得坐下。这时有三个女子陪着他问长问短，那四个女子到厨房去做饭。
page_text_en:
6 The group of women led Tang Sanzang into a stone cave. Looking up, Tang Sanzang saw that everything was made of stone—stone tables and stone benches—and felt a chill, exclaiming: 'This place is full of danger and lacks good fortune; it is not a good place!'
7 Tang Sanzang could not escape, so he had no choice but to sit down. At this time, three women stayed with him, asking him questions about his life, while the other four women went to the kitchen to cook.
summary_zh: 唐僧被众女子带入石洞，见洞内陈设阴森，心生恐惧；他无法脱身，只得坐下，三个女子陪他闲聊，另外四个女子去厨房做饭。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
长老，这是素斋，就勉强吃吧！
女菩萨，贫僧是胎里素，腥荤不敢进口。
8 不大一会，便端来了几盘腥气扑鼻的人肉、兽肉给唐僧吃。唐僧一见战战兢兢地连忙摆手，一面解释，一面拱手告辞。
9 送上门的买卖，哪里肯放！众女子一下把门关上，指着唐僧道：“你往哪里走！”说时迟，那时快，众女子一拥上前，把唐僧扑倒在地，绑起来高吊在梁上。
page_text_en:
Elder, this is vegetarian food, please eat it anyway!
Dear Bodhisattva, I am a lifelong vegetarian and dare not eat meat or fish.
8 After a short while, several plates of stinking human and animal meat were brought to Tang Sanzang. Seeing this, Tang Sanzang trembled and hurriedly waved his hands, explaining while bowing to decline.
9 A gift delivered to our doorstep—how could we let him go! The women quickly shut the door and pointed at Tang Sanzang, saying, “Where are you going!” Before he could react, the women rushed forward, knocked him to the ground, tied him up, and hung him high from the beam.
summary_zh: 唐僧拒绝食用蜘蛛精们端来的人肉兽肉，众女子见其不肯就范，便将其扑倒、捆绑并高吊在梁上。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
10 接着，那七个女子吐出丝绳，盘成大网，立刻把庄门布满了。唐僧在梁上暗暗叫苦道：“徒弟们，快来救我吧，来晚了，恐为师性命难保！
11 再说悟空、八戒、沙僧三人在路旁等得很不耐烦，悟空跳上树杈观看，吃惊道：“不好了，前面庄院放出白光，恐怕师父遇上妖魔了！”
page_text_en:
10 Then, the seven women spat out silk threads, coiling them into a large net that instantly covered the courtyard gate. Tang Sanzang, hanging from the beam, whispered in distress: "Disciples, come save me quickly! If you're late, I fear my life will be in danger!"
11 Meanwhile, Wukong, Baijie, and Sha僧 were waiting by the roadside, growing impatient. Wukong climbed onto a tree branch to look and exclaimed in shock: "Oh no! The courtyard ahead is emitting white light. I fear our master has encountered a demon!"
summary_zh: 本页描绘了蜘蛛精用丝绳结网困住唐僧，唐僧在梁上呼救；同时，孙悟空等三人发现庄院放出白光，怀疑师父遇险。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
12 八戒嚷着要去救师父，悟空道：‘还是我老孙去吧。’
说了，整了整虎皮裙，拿出金箍棒，快步流星地跑向前去。
13 到了庄院跟前，只见那丝绳缠了有千百层厚，用手摸一摸，粘糊糊的沾人。悟空不知这是什么东西，刚要举棒去打，忽想：这软绳怎能打断？如若惊动了妖怪，缠住老孙，反而不妙。
page_text_en:
12 Pigsy shouted that he would go to save the Master, but Wukong said, 'Still, let me go.'
He said, adjusted his tiger-skin skirt, took out his Ruyi Jingu Bang, and ran forward swiftly.
13 Upon arriving at the courtyard, he saw that the silk ropes were wrapped hundreds of layers thick. When he touched them, they were sticky and clung to his hand. Wukong didn't know what this was. Just as he was about to raise his staff to strike, he suddenly thought: How could this soft rope be broken? If I startle the demons, they might entangle me instead, which would be disastrous.
summary_zh: 孙悟空决定独自前去救师父，他整装后快步前往庄院。到达后，他发现庄院被千层厚的粘丝绳缠绕，犹豫是否用金箍棒击打，担心惊动妖怪反被缠住。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
14 好大圣，念了一个咒儿，立刻把土地老儿给拘来了。细问原由，才知这里是盘丝洞，洞里有七个女妖，都是蜘蛛成精。
15 悟空打听清楚，回来告诉八戒。八戒听说是打女妖精，心中喜欢，举着铁钯，甩开大步，直往盘丝洞跑去。
page_text_en:
14 Good Great Sage, after reciting a spell, immediately summoned the Earth God. After questioning him, he learned that this was the Spider Cave, where there were seven female demons, all spiders turned into spirits.
15 Wukong, having learned the truth, returned to tell Bajie. Upon hearing that they were going to fight female demons, Bajie was delighted, raised his rake, and strode off towards the Spider Cave.
summary_zh: 孙悟空通过召唤土地神得知此地为盘丝洞，住有七个蜘蛛精；随后他将消息告知猪八戒，八戒听后兴奋地举着铁钯奔向盘丝洞。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
16 八戒闯进盘丝洞，洞内不见人影，便稀哩糊涂地往里走。
17 又过一个洞口，见七个女妖正在洗澡，还听她们说洗完澡后吃唐僧肉哩。八戒大喝一声，举钯就打
page_text_en:
16 Pigsy burst into the Disk Silk Cave. Seeing no one inside, he walked in confusedly.
17 Passing another cave entrance, he saw seven female demons bathing and heard them say they would eat Master Tang's flesh after bathing. Pigsy roared and raised his rake to attack.
summary_zh: 猪八戒闯入盘丝洞，起初洞内无人，他稀里糊涂地往里走；随后在另一个洞口发现七个女妖正在洗澡，并听到她们计划吃唐僧肉，八戒大怒，举钯就打。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
18 众女妖见闯进一个黑脸和尚，又羞又怕，便一齐吐出丝绳，把八戒缠住。八戒左冲右撞，一连摔了好多跟斗，最后倒在地上再也起不来了。众女妖一哄而散。
19 女妖们回到前洞，把螳螂、蚂蜂、斑蝥、牛蜢、蜻蜓等众小妖都唤了来，叫他们好好把守洞口。
page_text_en:
18 The female demons saw a dark-faced monk burst in. Ashamed and frightened, they all spat out silk threads to bind Zhu Bajie. Bajie struggled left and right, fell over many times, and finally collapsed on the ground, unable to get up. The female demons then scattered in a panic.
19 The demons returned to the front cave and summoned various small demons—mantises, hornets, blister beetles, grasshoppers, and dragonflies—ordering them to guard the cave entrance carefully.
summary_zh: 猪八戒闯入盘丝洞，被蜘蛛精们用丝绳缠住，挣扎后倒地不起；女妖们散去后，又召集螳螂、蚂蜂等小妖把守洞口。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
20 再说八戒清醒过来，一看丝网已经没有了，连忙爬起来走回去。见了悟空、沙僧，把自己如何被缠住，如何醒来已不见女妖的事说了一遍。
21 沙僧听了叫道：‘不好了，那女妖一定回洞去伤害师父了，我们赶快去救师父吧！’三人慌了手脚，连忙赶往盘丝洞，去搭救师父。
page_text_en:
20 Then, after waking up, Bajie saw that the silk net was gone and hurriedly got up and walked back. He told Wukong and Sha Wujing about how he had been entangled and how, upon waking, the female demons were nowhere to be found.
21 Sha Wujing cried out: 'Oh no! Those demons must have returned to the cave to harm our master! We must go save him quickly!' The three of them panicked and hurried towards the Spider Cave to rescue their master.
summary_zh: 猪八戒从被蜘蛛精丝网缠住中醒来，发现丝网消失，便返回向孙悟空和沙僧报告遭遇；沙僧听后担心师父安危，三人立即赶往盘丝洞营救唐僧。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
22 他们来到洞口，只见有几个小妖拦住去路。八戒性急，不由分说，举起钯来就打。
23 小妖见八戒凶猛，一个个现了本相，变成千百万个飞虫，直向八戒、沙僧、悟空满身满头叮来。
page_text_en:
22 They arrived at the cave entrance and saw several small demons blocking their way. Bajie, impatient, didn't hesitate and raised his rake to attack.
23 The small demons, seeing Bajie's ferocity, revealed their true forms one by one, transforming into millions of flying insects that swarmed toward Bajie, Sha Wujing, and Wukong, biting them all over their bodies and heads.
summary_zh: 孙悟空、猪八戒和沙僧来到盘丝洞口，遇到小妖阻拦，八戒性急举钯攻击；小妖现出原形，化作无数飞虫向三人扑来。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
24 悟空见势不好，拔下一把毫毛，吹口气，变成无数老鹰。一刻工夫就把这些小虫吃完了。
25 师兄弟三人打进石洞，找到了师父，赶紧把师父解了下来。
page_text_en:
24 Wukong, seeing the situation was bad, plucked a handful of hairs, blew on them, and turned them into countless eagles. In a moment, they ate up all the insects.
25 The three disciples fought their way into the stone cave, found their master, and quickly freed him.
summary_zh: 孙悟空用毫毛变出老鹰吃掉小妖，随后师兄弟三人攻入石洞，救下被绑的唐僧。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
26 他们又找那些女妖，不料踪影全无。沙僧道：“咱们快扶师父走吧。”于是三人把三藏扶上马，放火烧了盘丝洞，继续西行。
27 师徒四人离开盘丝洞，没走多远，见有一处楼阁。走到跟前一看，上写“黄花观”三字。师徒们紧跑了一程，有些口渴，便上前去募杯茶吃。
page_text_en:
26 They searched for the female demons again, but found no trace. Sha Wujing said, "Let's quickly help Master up and go." So the three of them lifted Sanzang onto the horse, set fire to the Spider Cave, and continued their journey west.
27 The four disciples left the Spider Cave and hadn't gone far when they saw a pavilion. Upon approaching, they saw the three characters "Huanghua Temple" written on it. After running a short distance, feeling thirsty, they went forward to ask for a cup of tea.
summary_zh: 师徒四人救出唐僧后，放火烧了盘丝洞，随后在附近发现一座名为“黄花观”的楼阁，因口渴前去讨茶。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
28 唐僧上前，正要叫门，忽听“吱”地一声，门开处
走出一个道人，假惺惺地请唐僧师徒进去歇息。
29 原来盘丝洞的七个女妖，和这个老道是师兄妹。女
妖们吃了败仗，到这里求救。他们料定唐僧师徒必从这里
经过，便配下毒药，陷害唐僧师徒。不一会，老道便叫童
子端毒茶献上。
page_text_en:
28 Tang Sanzang stepped forward, about to knock on the door, when suddenly he heard a 'creeeak' as the door opened. A Taoist priest came out, pretending to be hospitable, and invited Master Tang and his disciples to rest inside.
29 It turned out that the seven female demons from the Disk Silk Cave were siblings with this old Taoist. The female demons, having suffered defeat, came here for help. They anticipated that Master Tang and his disciples would pass by, so they prepared poison to trap them. Soon after, the old Taoist ordered a boy servant to bring poisoned tea.
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒来到黄花观，被假意热情的道人邀请入内歇息；原来此道人是盘丝洞女妖的师兄，女妖们败退后前来求救，已配好毒药，准备用毒茶加害师徒。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
30 唐僧口渴，端起茶杯就喝了。八戒、沙僧也喝了。
妖道心中暗暗得意。
31 悟空眼尖心灵，见老道的茶杯不一样。心想这里面一定有鬼，就假意吃茶，眼睛却暗暗瞧着老道的动静，见老道得意的劲头，早料定了八分。
page_text_en:
30 Tang Sanzang, thirsty, picked up the teacup and drank. Zhu Bajie and Sha Wujing also drank.
The demon monk felt secretly pleased.
31 Wukong, sharp-eyed and clever, noticed the old Taoist's teacup was different. He thought there must be something suspicious, so he pretended to drink tea, while secretly watching the old Taoist's movements. Seeing the old Taoist's smug expression, he had already guessed eight-tenths of the truth.
summary_zh: 唐僧、猪八戒和沙僧在黄花观喝了道人递来的茶，道人暗自得意；孙悟空则察觉茶杯异常，怀疑有诈，暗中观察道人，已猜出八分。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
32 顷刻间，只见八戒面孔变色，沙僧两眼流泪，唐僧口吐白沫，一个个都晕倒在地。
33 悟空指着道士大怒道：‘你看我们这三个人是怎么的？’
道士冷笑道：‘你们毁了盘丝洞，现在休想逃出我的手心！’
说着拔剑就砍，悟空掣出金箍棒，急忙招架。
page_text_en:
32 In an instant, Pigsy's face turned pale, Sandy's eyes filled with tears, and Tang Sanzang spat white foam — all of them collapsed to the ground.
33 Wukong pointed at the Taoist and roared angrily: 'Look at what has happened to these three of us!'
The Taoist sneered: 'You destroyed the Spider Cave; now you can't escape from my grasp!'
As he drew his sword to strike, Wukong pulled out his Golden Cudgel and hurriedly blocked the attack.
summary_zh: 唐僧、猪八戒和沙僧饮下毒茶后中毒晕倒，孙悟空识破阴谋后与黄花观道士展开激战。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
34 这时，七个女妖一齐出来给道士助战。悟空双手轮棒，毫不畏惧。女妖见不是悟空对手，便吐起丝绳，搭了个天篷，把悟空盖在下面。
35 悟空看势不妙，一个筋斗，冲破天篷逃了出去。
page_text_en:
34 At this moment, seven female demons came out to help the Taoist priest in battle. Wukong swung his staff with both hands, fearless. Seeing they were no match for Wukong, the demons spat silk threads, forming a canopy overhead to trap him.
35 Seeing the situation was dire, Wukong did a somersault and broke through the canopy, escaping.
summary_zh: 孙悟空与黄花观道士激战，七个女妖前来助战并用丝绳织成天篷困住悟空，悟空见势不妙，一个筋斗冲破天篷逃出。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
36 悟空见蛛丝网罩了黄花观，便拔下毫毛，吹口仙气，立刻变成无数小猴，每人使双角叉棒一根，一声唿哨，照准丝网乱打起来。
37 丝绳网都被搅断了，从里面拖出七个大蜘蛛，每个足有巴掌大，一个个缩做一团，口喊“饶命！”
page_text_en:
36 Wukong saw the spider silk net covering Huanghua Pavilion, so he plucked out a strand of hair, blew a breath of immortal qi, and instantly transformed into countless little monkeys. Each held a double-pronged fork, and with a single whistle, they attacked the silk net wildly.
37 The silk net was torn apart, and seven huge spiders were dragged out from inside. Each was as big as a palm, shrinking into balls and crying out, 'Spare our lives!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空用毫毛变出无数小猴，击破黄花观的蛛丝网，将七个大蜘蛛拖出并使其求饶。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
38 悟空寻着道士，叫道：“快还我师父、师弟来。”那些妖怪高声叫道：“师兄，快还他唐僧，救我们性命！”那道士却说：“我要吃唐僧肉哩！救不得你们了。
39 悟空一听，十分恼怒，骂道：“你既不还我师父，且看你师妹的下场！”说着举起铁棒，把七个蜘蛛精，打得稀烂。
page_text_en:
38 Wukong searched for the Taoist and shouted, “Quickly return my master and my brothers!” The demons cried out, “Brother, return Tang Sanzang to us and save our lives!” The Taoist replied, “I want to eat Tang Sanzang’s flesh! I can’t save you.
39 Wukong, upon hearing this, became extremely angry and scolded, “If you won’t return my master, then see what happens to your sisters-in-law!” Saying this, he raised his iron staff and beat the seven spider demons into pieces.
summary_zh: 孙悟空质问黄花观道士归还师父和师弟，道士拒绝并声称要吃唐僧肉；悟空大怒，举起铁棒将七个蜘蛛精打得稀烂。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
40 悟空打死蜘蛛精，又去追打黄袍老道。他两个战有五六十回合，道士不能取胜，就放出法宝“千只眼”，眼中放出万道金光。
41 这金光把悟空照得懵头转向。悟空往左往右，都躲不开金光。心中一急，向地下钻去，一气钻出二十里，才逃了出来。
page_text_en:
40 Wukong killed the spider demons and then chased after the yellow-robed old Taoist. They fought for fifty to sixty rounds, but the Taoist could not win, so he released his magical treasure, the 'Thousand Eyes,' which emitted countless beams of golden light.
41 This golden light dazzled Wukong, making him disoriented. No matter which way he turned, left or right, he couldn't escape the light. In a panic, he dug underground and burrowed twenty miles before finally escaping.
summary_zh: 孙悟空打死蜘蛛精后追打黄袍老道，二人激战五十回合，老道放出法宝“千只眼”发出金光，悟空被金光所困，急中生智钻入地下二十里才逃脱。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
42 悟空只觉得满身疼痛，身软无力，不由地坐在地上落下泪来。正在这时，远处走来了一个老妇人。
43 这老妇人走到悟空跟前问他为何啼哭？悟空揩了一下眼泪把方才的事情说了一遍，又难过地说：“这一下，我师父师弟的性命难救了。”
page_text_en:
42 Wukong felt his whole body aching, weak and powerless, and couldn't help sitting on the ground, shedding tears. At that moment, an old woman came from afar.
43 The old woman walked up to Wukong and asked him why he was crying. Wukong wiped away his tears, told her what had just happened, and then sadly said, "This time, my master and brothers' lives are beyond saving."
summary_zh: 孙悟空因战斗受伤，感到疼痛无力，坐在地上哭泣，一位老妇人上前询问，悟空向她讲述了师父和师弟中毒的经过，并感到绝望。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
44 老妇人告诉他紫云山千花洞中有位菩萨叫毗蓝婆，他能降这妖怪。悟空问她这山坐落何方？怎样去法？老妇人用手指道：‘往南便是。’悟空回头看时，那妇人便不见了。
45 悟空驾筋斗云，来到紫云山千花洞。在洞的深处，看见一个女道姑坐在榻上。悟空想：这一定是那个菩萨了，就上前施礼，说明原由，求她去搭救师父。
page_text_en:
44 The old woman told him that there was a Bodhisattva named Pílán pó in the Thousand Flowers Cave on Purple Cloud Mountain, who could subdue this demon. Wukong asked her where the mountain was located and how to get there. The old woman pointed with her finger: 'It's to the south.' When Wukong turned back, the woman had vanished.
45 Wukong rode the筋斗 cloud to the Thousand Flowers Cave on Purple Cloud Mountain. Deep in the cave, he saw a female Taoist nun sitting on a couch. Wukong thought: This must be the Bodhisattva. He approached, bowed respectfully, explained the situation, and begged her to rescue his master.
summary_zh: 孙悟空在老妇人指引下前往紫云山千花洞，见到女道姑毗蓝婆，上前施礼并请求她搭救师父。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
46 那菩萨答应下来，和悟空一起驾了云头，一会儿到了黄花观。那菩萨取出一根绣花针，向空中一抛，只听一声巨响，破了金光。
47 悟空随同菩萨按下云头，走入观里，见那道士不能动弹，现了原形，原来是个蜈蚣精。悟空举棒要打，菩萨扯住道：‘大圣不要打，快救你师父去吧！’
page_text_en:
46 The Bodhisattva agreed and, together with Wukong, rode on the clouds, arriving at Huanghua Temple in a moment. The Bodhisattva took out a needle, threw it into the air, and with a loud crash, broke the golden light.
47 Wukong followed the Bodhisattva down from the clouds and entered the temple. He saw the Taoist priest unable to move, revealing his true form — a centipede demon. Wukong raised his staff to strike, but the Bodhisattva held him back, saying, 'Great Sage, don't hit him. Hurry and save your master!'
summary_zh: 菩萨与孙悟空一同来到黄花观，用绣花针破除金光，现出黄袍老道的蜈蚣精原形，菩萨阻止孙悟空击杀，催促他去救师父。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
48 他们到了正殿，只见师徒三人都倒在地上吐白沫。悟空道：“这如何是好？”菩萨道：“我带有解毒丸，吃了便好。”于是便往每人嘴里放了一粒。
49 过了一刻，三个人都醒过来了。悟空忙道：“师父、师弟，快来谢过菩萨。”唐僧、八戒、沙僧忙向菩萨行礼致谢。毗蓝婆菩萨收了蜈蚣精便驾云回山去了。
page_text_en:
48 They arrived at the main hall and saw the master and his three disciples lying on the ground, foaming at the mouth. Wukong said, "What shall we do?" The Bodhisattva said, "I have antidote pills; if they eat them, they'll be fine." So she put one pill into each of their mouths.
49 After a moment, all three woke up. Wukong hurriedly said, "Master, disciples, come and thank the Bodhisattva." Tang Sanzang, Zhu Bajie, and Sha Wujing hurriedly bowed to the Bodhisattva to express their gratitude. Pílán pó Bodhisattva took back the centipede demon and flew back to her mountain.
summary_zh: 孙悟空与菩萨来到黄花观，发现唐僧师徒三人中毒倒地，菩萨用解毒丸救醒他们，随后收服蜈蚣精并驾云离开。

title_en: The Monkey King 27: The Spider Cave
source_file: 连环画《西游记27：盘丝洞》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
50 悟空放了一把火烧了黄花观。唐僧师徒急忙收拾了行李马匹，又向西天行进。欲知后事，请看《智战三魔》

50 Wukong set fire to Huanghua Temple. Tang Sanzang and his disciples hurriedly packed their luggage and horses, then continued their journey westward. To learn what happens next, please read 'Intelligent Battle Against Three Demons'.
